say:1:1410216001:1.text: Impressive. It's such an efficient setup. And the weapons come out fast.
say:1:1410216001:1.source_cn: 真是了不起的生产线啊，这么快就能产出武器成品。

say:2:1410216002:1.text: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.
say:2:1410216002:1.male: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.
say:2:1410216002:1.female: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.

choice_prompt:3:1410216002.text: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.
choice_prompt:3:1410216002.source_cn: 没想到我和<style=stress><player_name></style>第一次尝试就能锻造出这样的作品。
choice_prompt:3:1410216002.male: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.
choice_prompt:3:1410216002.female: I didn't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I to make something so decent on our first try.

say:4:1410216003:1.text: Although... the sharpness and durability of our blades seem a bit lacking.
say:4:1410216003:1.source_cn: 只不过……奇怪，我们锻造出的刀剑，锋利和韧性上，总是多...

say:6:1410216004:1.text: That's 'cause you were using the beginner's method with scrap materials. If you used our—
say:6:1410216004:1.source_cn: 那是因为你们用的是新人练手的工艺，矿料都是最差的边角料...

say:9:1410216006:1.text: Ah! My apologies. The production line still needs my attention. I'll be right back!
say:9:1410216006:1.source_cn: ……呃，抱歉！生产线还需要我，我先走了。

say:11:1410216007:1.text: Please excuse Hyla's... directness. She's a bit of a perfectionist, but don't take it to heart.
say:11:1410216007:1.source_cn: 不好意思，诸位特使，海拉容易得意忘形，大家别计较。

say:12:1410216008:1.text: By the way, we've got a tradition here. Tonight, we host a feast to welcome you all! It's a dwarven custom, so please, make yourselves at home.
say:12:1410216008:1.source_cn: 对了，晚上按照我们矮人的传统，得给各位准备一场接风宴，...

say:13:1410216009:1.text: A feast isn't necessary. But Chief, does your village happen to have any unique materials?
say:13:1410216009:1.source_cn: 宴会什么的就不必了，只是村长，贵村难道有什么与众不同的...

say:14:1410216010:1.text: Well, yes! Minerals and ores are the lifeblood of us dwarves. Without them, we'd have to find a new home.
say:14:1410216010:1.source_cn: 那个，矿产肯定是有的！矿产是我们矮人的命根子，要是没有...

say:15:1410216011:1.text: As for something unique... The celestrite we mine is quite famous. Though, I doubt it's anything remarkable for such knowledgeable envoys. *Chuckle*
say:15:1410216011:1.source_cn: 至于与众不同，我们的天青矿倒是非常有名，不过肯定入不了...

say:16:1410216012:1.text: But don't decline tonight's welcome banquet! The whole village has been looking forward to it!
say:16:1410216012:1.source_cn: 倒是今晚的接风宴，特使大人可千万不要推辞了，这是我们矮...

say:17:1410216013:1.text: I understand... In that case, I humbly accept.

say:18:1410216014:1.text: Like you said before, there's no need to be so formal! The banquet won't be ready until the evening. I need to go oversee some things for now.
say:18:1410216014:1.source_cn: 不用客气！宴会得晚上才能准备完，我得去那边盯着点。

say:19:1410216015:1.text: In the meantime, feel free to explore the village.
say:19:1410216015:1.source_cn: 这段时间我就先失陪了，各位不妨在村里到处逛逛？

say:20:1410216016:1.text: I'm sure many would be willing to converse with you!
say:20:1410216016:1.source_cn: 想逛哪里都随意！每位矮人都会好好招待你们的！
